attacks.name: Swarili Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 3 or less, Push the target character Away |!range_small|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Mummy's Curse|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

attacks.name: Sever Soul
steps: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, this character gains a |<captured_soul_living_mummy>Captured Soul| token.

superPowers.name: Living Death
superPowers.body: This character may spend any number of Captured Soul tokens. For each Captured Soul token spent, this character may remove 1 special condition from itself, remove 1 |!damage| from itself, or gain 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Undead Empowerment
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, at the end of the |*Modify Dice| step, it may use this superpower. Spend one or more Captured Soul tokens. For each Captured Soul token spent in this way, this character may count 1 |!failure| result in its roll as a |!wild| for the remainder of the attack roll.

superPowers.name: Alchemical Curse of Nephrus
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage|, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

superPowers.name: Anubis‘s Soul Harvester
superPowers.body: When another character is Dazed or KO'd, this character gains a Captured Soul token. This character may have a maximum of three Captured Soul tokens at any time.
